title: Newfoundland-Style Nacho Hash
description: A twist on traditional nachos, this Newfoundland-Style Nacho Hash combines the flavors of the Canadian East Coast with the spicy kick of nachos. Perfect for a cozy dinner or snack.

ingredients.name: hash browns
ingredients.notes: use leftover hash browns or cook from scratch

ingredients.name: canadian bacon
ingredients.notes: or regular bacon, but Canadian bacon for a authentic touch

ingredients.name: newfoundland salt fish
ingredients.notes: or substitute with salmon or cod

instructions: Cook the Canadian bacon slices in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the cooked bacon and set aside.
Add the diced onions and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onions are translucent.
Add the grated potato hash and cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the flaked salt fish and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the shredded nacho cheese until melted and well combined.
Return the cooked Canadian bacon to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with cayenne pepper to taste.
Serve the Newfoundland-Style Nacho Hash hot and enjoy!
Optional: garnish with chopped fresh chives or scallions for added flavor and color.
